## Problem 1

n = 36

$\bar{x}$ = 23.4

sd (s) = 7.2

CI: $\bar{x} \pm$ t\* x SE

SE = $\frac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$

SE = $\frac{7.2}{\sqrt{36}}$ = 1.2

t\* = qt(1-(.04/2), 36) = 2.13

CI: 23.4 $\pm$ 2.13 \* 1.2

96% CI: (20.84,25.96)
